body: Most exterior painting in High Springs, FL involves wood. Clapboard and lap siding move with every change in humidity, and each board has a bottom edge where water collects and paint lifts first. Spray a thick coat over that and it will peel again within a few seasons. Wood needs a coating that breathes and flexes, and the boards need to be sound before it goes on.

Downtown, we also deal with porch columns, deep fascia, and decorative brackets. In Bridlewood and Bailey Estates, the mix shifts toward fiber cement, stucco accents, and builder-grade trim. Along the Poe Springs corridor, we often add outbuildings and long porches to the scope.

Mildew and algae grow on any surface here that stays damp long enough. Under trees and on north-facing walls, that's most of the year. If paint goes over live mildew, the growth will come back through it. We start with a soft wash that kills the growth at the root, then wait for the siding to dry completely. We take moisture readings on anything questionable, because wet wood under fresh paint causes the blistering described in our humidity and peeling paint article.

bullets: Scrape loose paint to a sound edge and feather-sand the transitions
Replace split or rotted clapboard, sills, and fascia to match existing profiles
Spot-prime bare wood and any boards bleeding tannin
Re-caulk butt joints and trim seams, leaving the lap edges open so the siding can breathe
Apply two coats of 100% acrylic from Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore, with a third on porous boards

faqs.q: Why does paint keep peeling on the shady side of my house?
faqs.a: Shaded walls stay damp longer, so mildew grows and moisture gets into the wood. Both break the bond between the paint and the siding. Treating the mildew, drying the wood, and priming bare spots fixes the cause.

faqs.q: Do you caulk every gap in clapboard siding?
faqs.a: No. Butt joints and trim seams get caulked, but the lap edges between boards are left open so moisture can escape. Sealing them can trap water in the wall.

faqs.q: Can you match old trim profiles when replacing boards?
faqs.a: We match existing profiles as closely as possible, and each replacement is listed on the estimate before any carpentry begins.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on exterior painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Exteriors carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, in addition to the paint manufacturer's product warranty.
